findings.file: tasks/doing/389-correct-issue-012-duplicate-id-claim-and-record-pin-drift.md — §Summary item 3, and §'3. pin 드리프트는 우연이 아니라 절차의 구조다' (heading and body)
findings.problem: F1/F2/F5 were folded into ISSUE-001 but not into the card that describes the edit. The card still asserts the refuted thesis verbatim: the heading '절차의 구조다', the Summary item 'pin 드리프트의 구조적 성격', and the body '카드를 닫는 행위(= quality-review 3줄 추가 + done/ 이동)가 리뷰 시점 pin을 무효화한다' — which repeats both the unscoped invalidation claim (F2) and the 3줄 miscount (F5, actually four lines). The card now contradicts the issue card it just corrected.
findings.impact: This card will be sealed into tasks/done/ as the record of the correction. Sealing a card that states the pre-correction claim reproduces exactly the ISSUE-010 situation both cards are about — a wrong sentence in a card nobody can amend afterwards.
findings.suggested: retitle §3 to name the digest choice as the cause, correct 3줄 to 넷, and scope the invalidation claim to the plain-sha256 pin. The frontmatter source: line and the card title already say 'plain-sha256 pin', so they need no change.

findings.problem: 'plain sha256은 blocks: 카드에서 canonical digest와 원리적으로 같아질 수 없으므로' — the two are both SHA-256 outputs over different inputs, so equality is astronomically improbable rather than impossible in principle. The operational conclusion is unaffected.
findings.suggested: no change needed unless the wording is being touched anyway.
